fusions.name: Dust Ignition
fusions.desc: Throws a cloud of spore dust that ignites on the first enemy it meets for 30 fire damage, 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Banked Embers
fusions.desc: Smouldering spores deal 4 fire damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance per hit to set it [Burning] for 4 seconds. The burning spreads on its own to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: After the Burn
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health, 8% more for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40% more. You carry 12% fire resistance.

fusions.name: Flashover
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs out on an enemy, an ember leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 6 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
